name: agora402
description: Agora402: an agent-to-agent services marketplace on Hedera. Discover, negotiate and pay per request over x402, settled through Blocky402, with HCS receipts.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/registry packages/seller packages/buyer scripts
